gaps.message: Without a reflog creation entry, start is the earliest of first branch commit, oldest reflog entry or first observed activity; value is partial and a lower bound.
Activity and session spans split at 30 min idle gaps; single-event sessions without a duration add no agent time.
Cross-source tool-call dedup needs a shared request/turn key; unkeyed reports count as-is. Session-level totals (codex ai.session) only used when a session has no per-turn data (partial).
Branch end uses pr.metadata payload.mergedAt; no collector emits it yet, so live branches close at snapshot as-of.
dx analyze has no --branch flag; AI events on other branches (e.g. Claude jsonl gitBranch=HEAD) are not in the main snapshot.
